prompt.title: Task / prompt
prompt.description: What should the agent do? It can use any MCP connectors you select below.
prompt.example: List the channels in my Slack workspace and summarize the most recent message in each.

mcpConnectors.title: MCP Connectors
mcpConnectors.description: Apify MCP Connector IDs to expose to the agent as tools. Each is served by this Actor at <container-url>/mcp/<connectorId> and forwarded to the Apify MCP Proxy, which injects your credentials. Leave empty to run the agent with only its built-in tools. Create connectors under Settings → Integrations → MCP Connectors.

mcpProxyOnly.title: MCP proxy only (debug)
mcpProxyOnly.description: If true, boot only the local MCP proxy and skip the Claude Managed Agent flow. The run stays alive until aborted so you can point an external MCP client at the container URL.
